metaDescription: Mastiff vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Mastiff boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Colostrum fade is the clock behind this Mastiff table, and doses at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks exist to immunize the puppy while exposure (parks, foster homes, boarding intros) is rising.
Boarding desks ask for finished Mastiff dates, not intentions, so a Mastiff with only the first DA2PP / DHPP dose is still incomplete for most facilities.
Hip dysplasia shows up often enough in Mastiffs that vaccine day is also screening day — keep both on the same visit when possible.
Store the rabies label with the Mastiff profile immediately; lost paperwork is the most common reason Mastiff travel and kennel check-ins stall.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Mastiff misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Mastiff series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Mastiff is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Mastiff away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Mastiff due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Mastiff core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Mastiff misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Mastiff health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Mastiff adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
